makabansa-1.question: Sino ang tinatawag na 'Ama ng Wikang Pambansa'?
makabansa-1.hint: Siya ang nagtatag ng Surian ng Wikang Pambansa.

makabansa-1.question: Tama ba na ang Luneta Park ay isang mahalagang lugar sa Maynila?
makabansa-1.hint: Ito ay isang kilalang makasaysayang parke sa ating bansa.

makabansa-1.question: Alin ang tawag sa lugar kung saan nagsimula ang ating kasaysayan bilang isang bansa?
makabansa-1.hint: Ito ay isang mahalagang lugar na may kinalaman sa ating mga bayani.

makabansa-1.question: Alin sa mga sumusunod ang larawan ni Jose Rizal?
makabansa-1.hint: Siya ang pambansang bayani ng Pilipinas.

science-1.question: Which part of the plant absorbs water and minerals?
science-1.hint: It grows underground and helps the plant get nutrients.

science-1.question: True or false: Leaves make food for the plant.
The ________ later helps form the fruit.
science-1.hint: This is the colorful part of a plant that helps in reproduction.

science-1.question: What part of the plant is shown in the picture?
science-1.hint: It is often colorful and attracts pollinators.

science-3.question: Which sense organ helps us see the things around us?
science-3.hint: We use this organ to see colors, shapes, and objects.

science-3.question: True or false: Our ears help us hear sounds.
science-3.hint: Ears allow us to listen to voices, music, and other sounds.

science-3.question: Which sense organ helps us smell flowers and food?
science-3.hint: We use this organ to detect different smells.

science-3.question: Which sense organ helps us taste food?
science-3.hint: This organ helps us recognize different flavors.

science-3.question: Which sense organ helps us feel if something is hot, cold, rough, or smooth?
science-3.hint: This organ covers and protects our whole body.

science-3.question: True or false: We use our eyes to hear sounds.
science-3.hint: We use our ears to hear sounds.

science-3.question: Which sense organ should you use to read a book?
science-3.hint: Reading requires the sense of sight.

science-3.question: Which sense organ helps you listen to your teacher?
science-3.hint: Sound enters the body through this organ.

science-3.question: True or false: The nose helps us identify different smells.
science-3.hint: Smelling is one of our five senses.

science-3.question: Which sense organ helps you know that a lemon tastes sour?
science-3.hint: This organ helps us recognize flavors.

science-3.question: Which sense organ helps you feel the softness of a pillow?
science-3.hint: The sense of touch allows us to feel textures.

science-3.question: True or false: The tongue is one of our sense organs.
science-3.hint: The tongue helps us taste different flavors.

science-3.question: Which sense helps you notice that a bell is ringing?
science-3.hint: You use your ears for this sense.

science-3.question: Which sense helps you know that a rose has a pleasant scent?
science-3.hint: You use your nose for this sense.

science-3.question: True or false: Skin helps protect our body while also helping us feel things.
science-3.hint: Skin is the organ responsible for the sense of touch.

science-3.question: Which sense helps you know that ice is cold when you touch it?
science-3.hint: Your skin detects temperature and texture.

science-3.question: Which sense organ helps you see the colors of a rainbow?
science-3.hint: The eyes are responsible for the sense of sight.

science-3.question: True or false: We can use our nose to taste food.
science-3.hint: The tongue helps us taste food.

science-3.question: What should you do to protect your eyes from very bright sunlight?
choices: Keep your eyes open in bright light
science-3.hint: Protecting your eyes from strong sunlight helps keep them safe.

science-3.question: What should you do to take care of your ears?
science-3.answer: Keep them clean and avoid very loud sounds
choices: Keep them clean and avoid very loud sounds
science-3.hint: Gentle care and avoiding loud noises help protect hearing.

science-3.question: True or false: We should put sharp objects inside our ears to clean them.
science-3.hint: Sharp objects can hurt the ear.

science-3.question: Which sense organs work together when you eat a delicious meal?
science-3.hint: Taste and smell work together to help us enjoy food.

science-3.question: Which sense helps you recognize the shape and color of a ball?
science-3.hint: Your eyes give you information about how things look.

science-3.question: True or false: Our five senses help us learn about and understand our surroundings.
science-3.hint: Sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch give us information about the world.

science-3.question: How many main sense organs do we commonly learn about in Grade 3?
science-3.hint: They are the eyes, ears, nose, tongue, and skin.
